note: Adapted from the original English description in Banks 1919. The original describes it as Nasutitermes intermedius, sp. nov., type in the M.C.Z. 10,079, type locality Arepo Savanna (Cumuto), Trinidad, collected by Roland Thaxter under Sphagnum; now placed in Cortaritermes. The original gives only one measurement for the soldier, head length 1.35 mm, and none for the worker; the alate is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head slightly longer than wide, the nasus rather long; about 10 long erect hairs on the front of the head, 2 on each side near the vertex, a row of 4 near the base of the nasus, and 1 on each side lower down; abdominal hairs very short, almost invisible, but the posterior margin bears longer bristles. Antennae of moderate length, the 3rd segment distinctly longer than the 2nd but less than twice as long, the 4th shorter than the 2nd. Worker with the usual large dark patches on either side of the upper part of the head, less dark than in N. morio, each patch bearing faint oblique lines running downwards from the vertex.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, the nasus slightly darker, the pronotum and antennae pale yellow; abdomen and legs almost without yellow, nearly transparent. Head length 1.35 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head covered with many minute hairs; the large dark patches on either side of the upper part of the head and the faint oblique lines over them are as described under "Diagnostic characters".
